events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Tribute to a legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Album that changed everything
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Widely considered a masterpiece, it was the sound of a band truly finding its artistic stride. What's your top track from the album?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the life and legacy of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: A lasting legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a musical visionary. John Lennon's message of peace and love continues to resonate. Which of his songs means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have marked the 80th birthday of the legendary 'Starman', David Bowie, born in 1947.

angles.name: Tribute to a legend
angles.copy: Forever changing music, fashion, and art. On what would have been his 80th birthday, we're celebrating the one and only David Bowie. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're turning up the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley. What's the one Elvis song you can't live without?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist, Jimmy Page, born in 1944.

angles.name: Guitar god's birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the maestro himself, Jimmy Page! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the 82nd birthday of the iconic rock and pop singer, Rod Stewart, born in 1945.

angles.name: Sir Rod's big day
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! An incredible career spanning decades. What's your go-to Rod song?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham 'Suggs' McPherson celebrates his 66th birthday today, born in 1961.

angles.name: It must be love!
angles.copy: One step beyond for Suggs, who's 66 today! The voice of Madness, bringing joy for decades. What's your favourite Madness moment?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the English pop and soul singer, Paul Young, born in 1956.

angles.name: Come back and stay
angles.copy: Paul Young is celebrating his 71st birthday today! From 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' to 'Every Time You Go Away', a true 80s icon. What's your top Paul Young track?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Here you come again
angles.copy: It's Dolly Parton's 81st birthday! An absolute icon, songwriter, and businesswoman. What's your favourite Dolly song or movie moment?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and singer-songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today, born in 1971.

angles.name: Forever love
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the one and only Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo hits, what's your top track from Gary?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the Trinidadian-British soul icon, Billy Ocean, born in 1950.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Get out your dancing shoes, because Billy Ocean is 77 today! Still 'Suddenly' making us want to move. What's your favourite Billy Ocean hit?

events.title: Rock Hall of Fame's first ceremony
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring legends like The Beatles and Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Hall of Fame history
angles.copy: 38 years ago, rock royalty gathered for the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who do you think was the most deserving of that first class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today, born in 1972.

angles.name: Shine on, Mark
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to the lovely Mark Owen! A key part of Take That's enduring success. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic Rooftop Concert
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Get Back to the rooftop
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their impromptu rooftop concert. An unforgettable moment in music. Which song from that day is your favourite?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Wishing a happy 76th birthday to the legendary musician, singer, and songwriter, Phil Collins, born in 1951.

angles.name: Against all odds
angles.copy: It's Phil Collins' 76th birthday! A true musical powerhouse, from Genesis to his incredible solo career. What's your favourite Phil Collins song?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today, born in 1981.

angles.name: Bringing SexyBack for 46
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From *NSYNC to solo stardom, he's still got that 'Suit & Tie' swagger. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the beloved British actor, Sir David Jason, born in 1940.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! What's your favourite Del Boy or Jack Frost moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event later known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: A tragic day in music history
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on the 68th anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 61st birthday to the 'Never Gonna Give You Up' star, Rick Astley, born in 1966.

angles.name: Never gonna give up on this birthday
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! What's your favourite Rickroll moment, or just your favourite of his timeless hits?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Today would have been the 82nd birthday of the reggae music icon, Bob Marley, born in 1945.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring spirit and music of Bob Marley. Which of his songs always brightens your day?

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to the legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, born in 1942.

angles.name: Natural Woman's birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible Carole King on her 85th birthday! A songwriting powerhouse and an iconic voice. What's your favourite Carole King composition?

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the iconic vocalist, Whitney Houston.

angles.name: The voice we miss
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost the incomparable Whitney Houston. Her voice remains as powerful and moving as ever. What's your favourite Whitney song?

events.title: Take That's original split anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, pop sensation Take That announced their original split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: When the boys said goodbye
angles.copy: It's been 31 years since the day Take That announced their original split, leaving fans devastated. Did you shed a tear? Thankfully, they came back stronger!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Wishing a happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the lead singer of UB40, born in 1959.

angles.name: Red, Red Wine and birthdays
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell! Still bringing those reggae vibes. What's your favourite UB40 track?

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Happy 36th birthday to the global superstar singer-songwriter, Ed Sheeran, born in 1991.

angles.name: Perfectly 36
angles.copy: Celebrating Ed Sheeran's 36th birthday today! From acoustic gigs to stadium tours, he's redefined pop. What's your go-to Ed Sheeran song?
